text:
alex: Heads-up — RedTeamX pen-test kickoff scheduled Mon 09:00 PT. Need to lock scope, vendor access model, RBAC changes, KMS questions, and retest window. Can we run through requirements here?

marta: Thanks. Is there a canonical intake doc for what evidence they can pull and where to drop it? Also need list of allowed tools (e.g., nmap, burp).

alex: Put a draft here: https://redwood.internal/security/pen-tests/rtx-2026-intake — includes allowed tools and scrubbed-data requirements. Key bits: no KMS decrypt access to production, supply tokenized sample data, and uploads only to presigned S3 path.

samir: On RBAC: vendor will need read-only access to some routes and a temporary service principal to run scans against staging. Recommend a short-lived role with just list/get on ECS/ALB and CloudWatch logs read. Prefer approach: create role + session policy TTL 8h and revoke after.

jen: Quick KMS question — if they need to validate encryption-at-rest is configured, can they get metadata without decrypt? We should avoid granting kms:Decrypt.

alex: Correct — only Describe* and GetKeyPolicy, no Decrypt. For any proof that data is encrypted, we can provide a sanitized sample and a signed statement from infra.

samir: Proposed Terraform snippet for temporary role (example):

```
resource "aws_iam_role" "pen_test_vendor" {
  name = "rtx-pen-test-2026"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.vendor_assume.json
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "rtx_readonly" {
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [
      { Action = ["logs:FilterLogEvents","logs:GetLogEvents","ec2:Describe*"], Effect = "Allow", Resource = "*" }
    ]
  })
}
```

samir: Then we use sts:AssumeRole with DurationSeconds=28800. Keep keys out of vendor control.

drew: Where should they upload findings/artifacts? We want immutable evidence store. Suggest dedicated S3 bucket with write-only presigned puts plus object-lock (governance mode) for retention. Path: s3://sec-pen-tests/rtx-2026/uploads/.

alex: +1. We'll enable CloudTrail and object-lock for that prefix. Also generate a short-lived presigned URL per report.

jen: For KMS grants, if we ever need to temporarily allow a check, use CreateGrant and limit with RetiringPrincipal and Name; otherwise avoid Decrypt. Example command: 

```
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:... --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rtx-pen-test --operations DescribeKey --name "rtx-scan-2026"
```

jen: Note: do NOT use CreateGrant to grant Decrypt for vendor-managed workloads.

marta: Triage process question: once vulns are in, do we track in security JIRA project or in the app team's backlog? We should unify to one epic per pen test with labels and severity.

samir: Preference: security creates the epic and triages to app teams as sub-tasks with severity and remediation owner. SLA target: P0 = 48h, P1 = 7 days. Add CVSS and CWE tags automatically via bot.

sec-bot: automated: PenTest record created (id: PT-2026-004). Upload bucket and presigned URL generated. Retest window reserved: 2026-05-18 to 2026-05-22.

alex: Incident response note — if vendor triggers active exploit, we treat as test-induced incident: on-call responds, isolate environment, vendor pauses. Need runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pen-test-incident. On-call: @marta @samir.

marta: Will review runbook and add contact numbers. Also adding a quick rollback play for DB migrations that might be hit during active scans.

alex: Proposed retest plan: vendor provides initial report within 5 business days; we triage and assign owners within 3 business days; then vendor gets a 2-week window for retest after fixes. Does that sound OK?

samir: Sounds good. Can we add automated verification scripts for a subset of findings (e.g., open ports, misconfigured CORS)? I can add checks to the security-probe repo.

jen: I'll validate the KMS/CMEK posture and provide a short checklist.

drew: I'll set up the S3 bucket + object-lock + presigned URL flow.

marta: I'll create the JIRA epic and templates, and prepare the canary dataset to hand to vendor.

alex: Great — please ack with :thumbsup: and I will confirm scope with vendor and finalize retest window.

samir: :thumbsup:

jen: :thumbsup:

marta: :thumbsup:

sec-bot: automated: Reminder scheduled 2026-04-30 09:00 PT to confirm scope with RedTeamX.

alex: Thanks all — I'll post a short checklist update in this thread after I talk to vendor tomorrow.
